description.en: Writes the "draw off" bitmask (see CMND_GET_DRAW_OFF_BIT), each set bit disabling rendering of a corresponding scene layer/element.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Turn off a specific draw bit while keeping the others untouched
CMND_SET_DRAW_OFF_BIT(now_bit_draw | _offBit);
